# Code of conduct

Treat other contributors with respect. Critique the code and ideas, not the person.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory abuse, sexual harassment, and sharing someone's
private information without permission are not acceptable. These rules apply to
issues, pull requests, and other project discussions.

Report conduct concerns privately to [shemtorga@gmail.com](mailto:shemtorga@gmail.com).
Include links or examples when possible. The maintainer may remove content or
restrict participation when these rules are broken.
